format:

    embed-resources: true
editor: visual
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(htmlwidgets)

#funcion para encontrar los genes mas expresados (logFCobjetivo vs LogFCotros)
encontrar_genes_top <- function(ref_matrix, n= 10) {
  top_markers_list <- list()
  
  for (ctype in colnames(ref_matrix)) {
    # Target vs Resto
    target_expr <- ref_matrix[, ctype]
    other_types <- ref_matrix[, colnames(ref_matrix) != ctype]
    rest_expr <- rowMeans(other_types)
    
    log_fc <- log2(target_expr + 1) - log2(rest_expr + 1)
    
    df <- data.frame(
      Gene = rownames(ref_matrix),
      Cluster = ctype,
      LogFC = log_fc,
      Expression = target_expr
    )
    
    # Ordenar y guardar los Top 10
    top_markers_list[[ctype]] <- head(df[order(df$LogFC, decreasing = TRUE), ], n)
  }
  
  return(do.call(rbind, top_markers_list))
}

```

## Panel 1K

Matriz de perfil de expresión del panel de 1k publicado por CosMx ([Link](https://github.com/Nanostring-Biostats/CosMx-Cell-Profiles/blob/main/Human/IO_1k/IO_1k.profiles.csv)) con su respectiva Categoria por tipo Celular.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#PANEL 1K
set_1k <- read.csv("~/Documents/Master/TFM/codigo/referencia_anotacion/IO_1k.profiles.csv")
rownames(set_1k) <- set_1k$X
set_1k <- set_1k[, -1]
set_1k <- as.matrix(set_1k)

#PANEL 1K - Info
path_1k_excel <- "~/Documents/Master/TFM/codigo/referencia_anotacion/LBL-11178-04-Human-Universal-Cell-Characterization-Panel-Gene-Target-List.xlsx"
df_1k_raw <- read_excel(path_1k_excel, sheet = "Annotations", skip = 1)

# Transformar de Matriz (+/-) a Lista (Gen -> Categoría)
list_1k <- df_1k_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Gene, 
    names_to = "Category", 
    values_to = "Membership") %>%
  # Filtro
  filter(Membership == "+") %>%
  select(Gene, Category) %>%
  filter(!Category %in% c("Add-On", "Core")) # Opcional: eliminar etiquetas de control

logfc_set1k<- encontrar_genes_top(set_1k, n=20)

df_merged <- merge(logfc_set1k, list_1k, by = 'Gene') %>%
  arrange(Cluster, Category, Gene) %>%
  select(Cluster, Category, Gene, LogFC, Expression) %>%
  mutate(
    LogFC = round(LogFC, 2),        
    Expression = round(Expression, 2))

datatable(
  df_merged,
  filter = 'top',
  extensions = 'RowGroup',
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 50,
    rowGroup = list(dataSrc = c(0, 1)), 
    order = list(list(0, 'asc'), list(1, 'asc')),
    scrollY = "600px", 
    autoWidth = TRUE

  ))
```

## Panel 6K

Matriz de perfil de expresión del panel de 6K publicado por CosMx ([Link](https://github.com/Nanostring-Biostats/CosMx-Cell-Profiles/blob/main/Human/LungCancer_6k/LungCancer_6k.profiles.csv)) con su respectiva Categoria por tipo Celular. Source Panel indica cual es el Target Biologico del gen (Cancer, Inmune o ambos)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
set_6k <- read.csv("~/Documents/Master/TFM/codigo/referencia_anotacion/LungCancer_6k.profiles.csv")
rownames(set_6k) <- set_6k$X
set_6k <- set_6k[, -1]
set_6k <- as.matrix(set_6k)

path_6k_excel <- "~/Documents/Master/TFM/codigo/referencia_anotacion/LBL-11190-04-Human-6k-Discovery-Gene-List.xlsx"
df_6k_cancer <- read_excel(path_6k_excel, sheet = "Cancer Annotations", skip = 1)
df_6k_inmuno <- read_excel(path_6k_excel, sheet = "Immunology Annotations", skip = 1)

# --- Procesar Cancer Annotations ---
list_6k_cancer <- df_6k_cancer %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Gene, names_to = "Category", values_to = "Membership") %>%
  filter(Membership == "+") %>%
  select(Gene, Category) %>%
  mutate(Source_Panel = "Cancer")

# --- Procesar Immunology Annotations ---
list_6k_immune <- df_6k_inmuno %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Gene, names_to = "Category", values_to = "Membership") %>%
  filter(Membership == "+") %>%
  select(Gene, Category) %>%
  mutate(Source_Panel = "Immunology")

# 1. Juntar ambas tablas una debajo de la otra
list_6k_combined <- bind_rows(list_6k_cancer, list_6k_immune)

# 2. Agrupar por Gen y Categoría para fusionar duplicados
list_6k_clean <- list_6k_combined %>%
  group_by(Gene, Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Source_Panel = paste(unique(Source_Panel), collapse = " & "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Gene, Category)

logfc_set6k<- encontrar_genes_top(set_6k, n = 20)

df_merged_6k <- merge(logfc_set6k, list_6k_clean, by = 'Gene') %>%
  arrange(Cluster, Category, Gene) %>%
  # ¡Importante! Añadimos Source_Panel para no perder de qué lista viene
  select(Cluster, Category, Gene, Source_Panel, LogFC, Expression) %>%
  mutate(
    LogFC = round(LogFC, 2),        
    Expression = round(Expression, 2)
  )

datatable(
  df_merged_6k,
  filter = 'top',
  extensions = 'RowGroup',
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 50,
    rowGroup = list(dataSrc = c(0, 1)), 
    order = list(list(0, 'asc'), list(1, 'asc')),
    scrollY = "600px",      
    scrollCollapse = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  )
)
```
